title: Electronic Service Provider
description: Definition of Electronic Service Provider under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a person who provides technologies or processes to enable a product seller to engage in advertising or selling goods or services to a consumer and includes any online market place or online auction sites
content.plain_language: a company or person that provides the technology for sellers to advertise or sell products to buyers online, including online marketplaces and auction sites
examples: Amazon providing a platform for third-party sellers
Flipkart enabling sellers to advertise products to consumers
non_examples: a physical store selling products directly to customers
a manufacturer producing goods without selling them online
